why: Give niche ideas enough room and a readership to develop.
how: Discover books, choose reading depth, examine claims and contribute through the actual site workflows.
what: A free, evolving library with concrete routes for readers, critics and contributors.
limitations: The librarian recommends catalogue books; it is not a general question-answering service.
Translations and animated introductions are only available for some editions.
Savings and superiority are conditional benefits of well-scoped, well-written books, not measured universal outcomes.

sceneReview.readerValue: Readers can follow an argument instead of rebuilding it through scattered answers.
sceneReview.metaphor: The library is a collection of distinct volumes; its name labels the collection, not a book.

sceneReview.readerValue: Each edition can build on what readers and experts have learned.
sceneReview.metaphor: Expert notes inform AI-assisted editions; readers contribute to subsequent revisions.

sceneReview.readerValue: That can reduce repeated AI computation, its energy use, and its cost.
sceneReview.metaphor: One developed book supports multiple readers, illustrating reuse rather than measured savings.

sceneReview.readerValue: A library can preserve that cultural diversity without requiring mass appeal.
sceneReview.metaphor: Different volumes represent different literary forms and small audiences.

sceneReview.readerValue: The librarian recommends books from this collection.
sceneReview.metaphor: A natural-language request produces catalogue recommendations through Ask AI Librarian.

sceneReview.readerValue: Some books also have an animated introduction.
sceneReview.metaphor: Short and complete reading editions belong to a book.

sceneReview.readerValue: If a translation is missing, you can request it.
sceneReview.metaphor: Language choices distinguish available editions from translation requests.

sceneReview.readerValue: Use Create to propose a missing book or contribute a document.
sceneReview.metaphor: Two contribution actions offer editing guidance or a proposed book, without naming a temporary delivery channel.

sceneReview.readerValue: Ask the librarian, find a book, and take the time to explore.
sceneReview.metaphor: The shared librarian returns the visitor to the collection.
